datasets.name: data_quality_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_quality_checks,
  COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_name) as unique_catalogs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT schema_name) as unique_schemas,
  COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) as unique_tables,
  SUM(CASE WHEN overall_result = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN overall_result = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failure_count,
  AVG(CASE WHEN completeness IS NOT NULL AND completeness != '' THEN TRY_CAST(completeness AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_completeness,
  AVG(CASE WHEN validity IS NOT NULL AND validity != '' THEN TRY_CAST(validity AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_validity,
  AVG(CASE WHEN consistency IS NOT NULL AND consistency != '' THEN TRY_CAST(consistency AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_consistency,
  AVG(CASE WHEN uniqueness IS NOT NULL AND uniqueness != '' THEN TRY_CAST(uniqueness AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_uniqueness,
  AVG(CASE WHEN accuracy IS NOT NULL AND accuracy != '' THEN TRY_CAST(accuracy AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_accuracy,
  AVG(CASE WHEN timeliness IS NOT NULL AND timeliness != '' THEN TRY_CAST(timeliness AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_timeliness,
  AVG(CASE WHEN integrity IS NOT NULL AND integrity != '' THEN TRY_CAST(integrity AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END) as avg_integrity
FROM (
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
) combined_data

datasets.name: quality_metrics_trends
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(current_timestamp) as quality_date,
  'Completeness' as metric_type,
  AVG(CASE WHEN completeness = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as metric_value
FROM (
  SELECT current_timestamp, completeness FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mysql 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT current_timestamp, completeness FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_redshift 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT current_timestamp, completeness FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_pgsql 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT current_timestamp, completeness FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_bigquery 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL

datasets.name: data_quality_details
queryLines:
SELECT
    catalog_name,
    schema_name,
    table_name,
    layer_name,
    completeness,
    validity,
    consistency,
    uniqueness,
    accuracy,
    timeliness,
    integrity,
    overall_result,
    current_timestamp
FROM (
    SELECT 
        catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, layer_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
        uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mysql
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_catalog_filter = 'ALL' OR catalog_name = :param_catalog_filter)
    AND (:param_schema_filter = 'ALL' OR schema_name = :param_schema_filter)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, layer_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
        uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_redshift
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_catalog_filter = 'ALL' OR catalog_name = :param_catalog_filter)
    AND (:param_schema_filter = 'ALL' OR schema_name = :param_schema_filter)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, layer_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
        uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_pgsql
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_catalog_filter = 'ALL' OR catalog_name = :param_catalog_filter)
    AND (:param_schema_filter = 'ALL' OR schema_name = :param_schema_filter)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, layer_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
        uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_bigquery
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_catalog_filter = 'ALL' OR catalog_name = :param_catalog_filter)
    AND (:param_schema_filter = 'ALL' OR schema_name = :param_schema_filter)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, layer_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
        uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mssql
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_catalog_filter = 'ALL' OR catalog_name = :param_catalog_filter)
    AND (:param_schema_filter = 'ALL' OR schema_name = :param_schema_filter)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, layer_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
        uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
    FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_snowflake
    WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
    AND (:param_catalog_filter = 'ALL' OR catalog_name = :param_catalog_filter)
    AND (:param_schema_filter = 'ALL' OR schema_name = :param_schema_filter)
) combined_data
ORDER BY current_timestamp DESC

datasets.name: table_quality_performance
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT(catalog_name, '.', schema_name, '.', table_name) as full_table_name,
  COUNT(*) as total_checks,
  AVG(CASE WHEN completeness = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_completeness,
  AVG(CASE WHEN validity = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_validity,
  AVG(CASE WHEN consistency = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_consistency,
  AVG(CASE WHEN uniqueness = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_uniqueness,
  AVG(CASE WHEN accuracy = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_accuracy,
  AVG(CASE WHEN timeliness = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_timeliness,
  AVG(CASE WHEN integrity = 'PASS' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 as avg_integrity,
  MIN(overall_result) as min_overall_result,
  MAX(overall_result) as max_overall_result
FROM (
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mysql 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_redshift 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_pgsql 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_bigquery 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mssql 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, completeness, validity, consistency, 
    uniqueness, accuracy, timeliness, integrity, overall_result, current_timestamp
  FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_snowflake 
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND current_timestamp BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 ) combined_data
GROUP BY catalog_name, schema_name, table_name
ORDER BY total_checks DESC

datasets.name: catalog_filter_options
queryLines:
SELECT 'ALL' as catalog_option
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT catalog_name as catalog_option
FROM (
  SELECT catalog_name FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND catalog_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT catalog_name FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND catalog_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT catalog_name FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND catalog_name IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
  SELECT catalog_name FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND catalog_name IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
  SELECT catalog_name FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND catalog_name IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
  SELECT catalog_name FROM migration_catalog.dataquality_schema.data_quality_log_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND catalog_name IS NOT NULL
) combined_catalogs
